section.name: Introduction
section.p: At any time, all the code in the Git repository should be compilable and should pass all unit tests. There is no guarantee that it will be fully featured—this is a work in progress.

section.name: Latest build
section.p: Continuous Integration automated builds are available at the HtmlUnit Build Server.
Sonatype hosts the HtmlUnit snapshot build, which is manually updated by the development team. If you need a recent build, feel free to contact us.
